categories.compatibility-character: ICU expands compatibility characters (ligatures such as ﬁ) to their letters; CFStringFold with these options does not.
categories.kana-variant: ICU treats hiragana and katakana as equal at primary strength; CFStringFold has no kana-insensitive option, so the key orders them by code point.
categories.long-digit-run: localizedStandardCompare compares digit runs numerically only while they fit in 64 bits; the key compares runs of up to 255 digits numerically (§4.2 rule 2).
categories.non-decomposable-letter: Letters such as ø, ł, œ, æ have no canonical decomposition, so CFStringFold keeps them; ICU sorts them next to their base letter.
categories.punctuation: ICU orders spaces < punctuation < symbols < digits by collation weight; the key uses folded UTF-8 code-unit order, and digit runs start with a length byte (0x01–0xFF).
categories.script-order: ICU root collation orders scripts (e.g. Hangul before Han); the key uses code-point order.
categories.tie-break: Folded keys are equal; the key tie-breaks on unfolded NFC bytes (uppercase before lowercase, more leading zeros first), ICU puts lowercase first.
